name: session
description: Session continuity toolkit: write a machine-local HANDOFF.md holding only current state (handoff) and resume from it by checking it against live repo facts, reporting drift, and stopping before any work starts (go), which also runs github:backlog when every NEXT item is already done and names the session after the first reply via a UserPromptSubmit hook. A SessionStart hook reminds Claude to run go when a HANDOFF.md exists.
